app.name: Sample Steps
app.one_liner: Parents see where their kids are on a map after school

users.moment: 3:30pm, wondering if they got to after-school club

core_loop.action: the child checks in at a place

social.cold_start: useful with one parent and one child

v1_features: child checks in at a saved place

decisions.question: Will children use it themselves?
decisions.answer: yes, ages 8-12, on their own phone
decisions.why: COPPA consent and the account model

decisions.question: Who agrees, and can the child see it's on?
decisions.answer: a parent sets up the child's profile; the child always sees who can see their check-ins
decisions.why: the account model and stalkerware line

decisions.question: Live location or last check-in?
decisions.answer: last check-in only, at saved places, visible to the parents the guardian added

decisions.question: How long is a location kept?
decisions.why: latest point only unless there's a reason

decisions.question: Can anyone else contact the child?

categories.why: shows a child's check-in location to parents

questions.answer: a parent sets up the child's profile
the child always sees who can see their check-ins
last check-in only, at saved places

abuse_cases.harm: locates the child against a court order
abuse_cases.mitigation: only the guardian who set up the profile adds viewers; every viewer is listed on the child's screen and to the other guardian

accepted.note: children use it with a parent-owned profile and verifiable consent
